description: Settings of the pull request gate (gatekeepers/pr): read by settings.py for the service
and the agents' pr_gate status tool. A variable set in the environment overrides its
The gated repositories are the folders marked pr_gated in context/paths.json; each clone's
origin names its GitHub repository. QUIZ_DEVELOPER empty: the account gh is signed in as.
projects: per folder name, QUIZ_BUILD_COMMAND, QUIZ_TEST_TARGET or QUIZ_FAIL_ON_WARNINGS
that replace the shared ones for that project, e.g. {"core_dump": {"QUIZ_TEST_TARGET": "test"}}.
QUIZ_MODEL_ATTEMPTS: maximum model replies per quiz, including the initial reply.
An invalid or unfinished reply is retried within this limit; 2 means one retry.
